title: Guides bundle run report
description: The optional run report, report.json, contract version 0.3. See section 5.2 of guides-contract.md. It is an output of a run, written beside the bundle directory and never inside it: it is not a bundle file, the portal keeps it, and it is never in the tenant's repository. Information only: nothing reads it to decide anything, and no run is given the report of an earlier one. Members not defined here are allowed at every level and are ignored by the portal. Every string is untrusted and is shown as plain text only. Each top-level array holds at most 1,000 items. Rules this schema does not express, each reported as invalid-report: the report is UTF-8 JSON of at most 2 MB, nested at most 64 deep, and no object in it has a duplicate key.

code.description: The generator's own name for the kind of problem. Not a code of the contract or of the portal's spec doctor.

severity.description: The generator's own scale. Unrelated to the severities of contract section 5.

fix.description: Advice in plain text. Not a patch; the portal never applies it.

extensions.description: One item per vendor extension (x- field) name seen in the spec. name, usedIn and example are text from the spec: untrusted, plain text only.

example.description: One value, as text. A value that is not a string is given as its JSON text. Cut by the generator to fit.

suggestedRole.description: The role the name suggests, from the generator's own set of roles. A suggestion changes no page.
